query: SELECT e.name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id

WITH department_avg AS (
    SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) as avg_salary
    FROM employees
    GROUP BY department_id
)
SELECT 
    e.name, 
    d.department_name, 
    e.salary,
    da.avg_salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.department_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) as rank_in_dept
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
JOIN department_avg da ON e.department_id = da.department_id
WHERE e.salary > da.avg_salary
ORDER BY d.department_name, rank_in_dept
